text:
viv: Opening a small PR to refresh the Hello Mini quickstart. Main goals: tighten the auth example, add a one-line first-deploy (docker run), and fix two stale links. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/521
ana: awesome. can we make the curl auth example a single-line minimal so it's copy-paste friendly? also call out the preferred env var name (REDWOOD_API_KEY) and show the old var in a migration note.
adrien: also add a one-liner health check after the docker run so users can confirm the sample started. e.g. `curl http://localhost:8080/health` and expected output `{"status":"ok"}`
viv: will do. keeping curl minimal and adding a short "what to expect" after running. removing redirecting link `/getting-started/local` -> `/deploy/run-on-local`.
docs-bot: preview build created: https://preview.redwood-inference.dev/pr/521 (status: building) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
nana: small doc nit: prefer fenced code blocks with ```bash for terminal examples and keep JS SDK snippet under 8 lines. learners prefer async/await first.
adrien: suggest pinning the sample image tag in the docker example to `redwood/hello-mini:0.2.0` and add a note about pinning for Dedicated/private.
viv: pinned to 0.2.0 and added an inline sentence about pinning for reproducible demos. added Troubleshooting mini-checklist for 401s -> check REDWOOD_API_KEY, confirm token scope, inspect network policy.
docs-bot: link-check: found 1 redirect and auto-fixed in commit (sha: e4a7d9) :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: preview redeployed for commit e4a7d9 (status: success) :white_check_mark:
nana: LGTM from me after the minor wording tweak on the migration note (use "deprecated" instead of "old").
viv: changed wording to "deprecated" and squashed commits. PR description lists changes: auth example, pinned docker image, link fixes, migration note, troubleshooting, expected output. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/521
adrian: approved, merging after CI. thanks :tada:
docs-bot: merged to main at 3659999350
